basic_details.short_information: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi (AUD) will hold a walk-in interview on 30 November 2026 to form a panel of Guest Faculty. Candidates must register between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM that day. The venue is G-3, Block-A, School of Vocational Studies (SVS), Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Shivaji Marg, Karampura Campus (Near Moti Nagar Metro Station), Delhi – 110 015. The panel has 12 category-wise positions in Tourism & Hospitality Management, Accounting & Finance, Early Childhood Education and Retail Management. content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The walk-in is for one post, Guest Faculty. Candidates will be engaged from the panel in Tourism & Hospitality Management, Accounting & Finance, Early Childhood Education and Retail Management. The notice says the vacancy may increase or decrease as per requirement while the panel is valid. The essential qualifications follow UGC Regulation 2018. The listed specialisations are: Accounting & Finance Retail Management Tourism & Hospitality Management Early Childhood Education Entrepreneurship development Sociology of education Psychology of education English language teaching Development of knowledge system etc. A candidate needs any one of the following three routes: Route A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed). The degree must be in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or be an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. The candidate must also have cleared NET conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET. Candidates who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. under the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M. Phil./ Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 are exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Route B: A Ph.D. degree from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by QS, the Times Higher Education (THE) or the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. Industry route: Minimum 5 years of working experience in the relevant industry, as listed under the specialisation, with a Master Degree with 55% marks. Some Ph.D. holders registered before July 11, 2009 are also exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Their degree is governed by the then existing Ordinances/Byelaws/Regulations of the awarding institution. The exemption applies only when all five conditions below are met: The Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the university concerned must certify these conditions. NET/SLET/SET is also not required for Masters programmes in disciplines for which the UGC, CSIR or a similar accredited body does not conduct NET/SLET/SET. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each specialisation. Experiences in teaching B. Voc. Programmes in the colleges/ universities and related industry experiences. These relaxations follow UGC Regulations, 2018: A relaxation of 5% is allowed at the Bachelor's and Master's level for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-creamy Layer). It is also allowed for Differently abled candidates in these groups: blindness and low vision; deaf and hard of hearing; locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy; autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; and multiple disabilities. The relaxation is based only on the qualification mark

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: At registration, candidates must bring all original certificates/mark sheets with an attested photocopy of each. They must also bring a recent passport size photograph and an updated Bio-data. The notice also asks for self-attested copies of the following, with originals (originals will be returned after verification): A valid Non Creamy Layer OBC – NCL (Delhi) certificate for the Financial Year 2026-27. It must be issued by the Competent Authority of the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi. A candidate who does not produce this certificate shall not be allowed for interview. Identity proof. Copies of publications the candidate may like to present before the Selection Committee. Certificate of Date of Birth (Class X/ School Leaving Certificate). Certificates of educational qualifications and experience. Experience letter as claimed. A No Objection Certificate from the present employer, if the application was not sent through proper channel. Without it, the candidate will not be allowed to appear in the interview. Certificate of belonging to a Reserved Category, if applicable. One passport size photograph. A Ph.D. compliance certificate in the format of Annexure I (Ph.D. registration on or after 11th July, 2009) or Annexure II (registration prior to 11th July, 2009). It must be issued by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) with seal and signature. Certificates issued by departments will not be valid. An Equivalence Certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities, New Delhi, for a Ph.D. from a foreign university. Without it, the Ph.D. degree will not be considered. Applicants serving in Government or Public Sector Undertakings (including Boards and Autonomous Bodies) must submit a No Objection Certificate on the prescribed proforma from the employer at the time of interview. Self-attested copies should be arranged strictly in the order and sequence mentioned in the application.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates register at the School of Vocational Studies (SVS) between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM on 30 November 2026. Candidates who do not fulfil the eligibility criteria will not be considered for the selection process. The selection may be by a presentation, a seminar, an interview, or a combination of these. The academic score as specified in Appendix II (Table 3A) for Universities will be considered only for short-listing candidates for interview. Selections will be based only on performance in the interview. Assessment will be based on evidence the applicant produces. Examples include copies of publications, project sanction letters, utilisation and completion certificates, patent filing acknowledgements and approval letters, and students' Ph.D. award letters. No TA/DA will be paid for document verification or the interview.

content_sections.text: Merely appearing in the interview does not give any right to appointment or selection. If wrong information is found at any stage, the candidature will be treated as cancelled. The University will process applications entirely on the basis of the information and documents submitted. Responsibility for false or incorrect information lies solely with the candidate. The candidate must specifically mention their category and provide the caste certificate issued by the Competent Authority. Any addendum or corrigendum will be posted only on the university website http://aud.ac.in/careers . Candidates are advised to visit the University website regularly for updates. The University reserves the right to revise, reschedule, cancel or withdraw the recruitment process in part or full without giving any reason. The University reserves the right to modify, withdraw or cancel any communication if a mistake is found, even after an appointment letter is issued. Any legal proceedings against the University fall under the territorial jurisdiction of the High Court of Delhi.

faq.question: Q1. When is the AUD Guest Faculty walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The AUD Guest Faculty walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026. Registration runs from 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the AUD Guest Faculty walk-in venue?
faq.answer: The venue is G-3, Block-A, School of Vocational Studies (SVS), Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University Delhi, Shivaji Marg, Karampura Campus (Near Moti Nagar Metro Station), Delhi – 110 015.

faq.question: Q3. How many Guest Faculty positions are there?
faq.answer: There are 12 positions: UR – 03, ST – 02, SC – 02, EWS – 02 and OBC – 03. They cover Tourism & Hospitality Management, Accounting & Finance, Early Childhood Education and Retail Management.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for AUD Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree with 55% marks in a relevant subject plus NET/SLET/SET, or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2009/2016. Alternatively, a Ph.D. from a top-500 ranked foreign university qualifies. A Master Degree with 55% marks plus minimum 5 years of relevant industry experience also qualifies.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AUD Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Superannuated teachers may be considered for engagement as Guest Faculty, subject to a maximum age limit of 70 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the honorarium for AUD Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The honorarium is ₹1500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/- per month as per UGC norms. Allowances, pension, gratuity and leave admissible to regular teachers are not given.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring all original certificates/mark sheets with an attested photocopy of each, a recent passport size photograph and an updated Bio-data. Also bring identity proof, date of birth proof, any applicable category or NOC certificates, and the Annexure I or II Ph.D. certificate if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. How will Guest Faculty be selected?
faq.answer: The selection may be by a presentation, seminar, interview or a combination of these. The academic score is used only for short-listing, and selections are based only on interview performance.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the AUD Guest Faculty panel valid?
faq.answer: The panel is valid for one year. Its validity may be extended till the ongoing Semester is completed, if required.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview or for document verification.
